title.narrative: Environmentally Sound Management and Final Disposal of PCBs

description.narrative: .The Project aims to establish an environmentally sound management system and dispose of 200 tons of PCBs contaminated equipment and wastes by strengthening the institutional capacities of oil and power sectors for sound management of chemicals
